# Berth coordination pilot overview

The Berth Coordination Pilot is a trial system designed to optimize berth scheduling and resource allocation at Port Azure. It aims to reduce vessel waiting times by synchronizing crane telemetry data, customs clearance status, and container tracking updates. Key terms include "berth window," "turnaround time," and "dwell time." Typically, the Port Operations Manager owns this pilot, collaborating closely with terminal operators and shipping agents. Its success is measured by improved berth utilization rates and lower operational delays, enhancing overall port efficiency.
